verdict.rationale: Moss ships an official CLI: its docs describe installing and using it from the terminal, show concrete commands (`moss login`, `moss keys create/list/delete`), and a probe confirms it lives in the official repo under packages/moss-cli. Only key management is evidenced, so the depth of the CLI is thin. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands beyond auth and key management (e.g. index and query operations), agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install and use the Moss CLI from the terminal.
You can also manage keys from the terminal with the Moss CLI: `moss login`, then `moss keys create`, `list` or `delete`.
